purpose: Per-tool acceptance for project-owned persistent environments. Each row states what was exercised and HOW STRONG the evidence is, so nothing reads as verified because a mock agreed with itself.

evidenceLevels.real-guest: Exercised against a real rootless Podman container in an exclusively created private store.
evidenceLevels.unit: Exercised against in-process fakes only. Proves the logic, not that the guest behaves this way.
evidenceLevels.unverified: No acceptance yet at any level, or only indirect coverage.
